compiled_state.title: [test_integration_full_loop]: _VALID_SEVERITIES defined locally instead of imported -> Severity list can drift from dispatch.py source of truth
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 76b4f44ed61435926011c38fe4c1a6ff6a0cff10

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick

#### Expected Behavior

The set of valid severity values should be imported from `dso_ci_review.dispatch` (or a shared constants module) so the integration test always validates against the same list the dispatcher enforces.

#### Actual Behavior

`tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_integration_full_loop.py:34` defines `_VALID_SEVERITIES` as a local set:
```python
_VALID_SEVERITIES = {"critical", "important", "minor", "fragile", "fallback_exhausted"}
```

This duplicates severity definitions from `dispatch.py`. If `dispatch.py` adds or removes a severity value, the integration test continues to pass against the old set without raising a signal.

comments.body: Fixed: Added _VALID_SEVERITIES as a frozenset constant to dispatch.py and replaced the local hardcoded definition in test_integration_full_loop.py with an import from dso_ci_review.dispatch, ensuring the test always reflects the source of truth.
comments.author: Test
